reason: The baseline comparison was not a comparison. Baselines ran under DNU_BASELINE_MAX_TOKENS=160 while full_aura ran the same prompts through the live message path with a 240s budget and effectively unbounded tokens, on tasks (coding, planning, self-debug, transfer) that cannot be answered inside 160 tokens at all. The baselines ran out of tokens before emitting an <answer> tag and were scored no_answer. full_aura additionally had a deterministic symbolic solver the baselines did not. The identical 0.1667 across three structurally different baselines is the signature of the handicap, not of three independent measurements agreeing.
scope: Every baseline-relative number in this bundle: raw_llm, llm_with_tools and react_agent pass rates, and any full_aura-versus-baseline gap derived from them.

The ablation set, which isolates System 2 only. Removing persistent memory, volition, Will authority, self-repair or affect-steering each left the score at 1.0, so this bundle measures the contribution of System 2 and says nothing about the contribution of the rest of the architecture.
Any AGI-candidate classification resting on the above.
what_remains_valid: The grader itself is condition-independent (salted hash of the normalized answer), so full_aura's own 100/100 on the 100-task battery stands as a record of what full_aura scored on that battery.
That number is an absolute score against a project-authored battery. It is not evidence of superiority over anything, because nothing was fairly compared against it.
replacement_requirements: Identical token and wall-clock budget for every condition.
Identical tool access, or an explicitly declared and separately reported tool-access arm.
The solver available to every condition or to none.
Ablations that remove each subsystem in turn, not System 2 alone.
Every attempt counted, including crashes, retries, fallbacks and human intervention.
The battery authored or administered by someone other than this project, or clearly labelled as self-authored.
note: The measured files are deliberately left byte-identical. What was measured is a fact and stays on the record; this sidecar states what that measurement does and does not support. Editing the numbers would destroy the evidence that the handicap existed.
